notes: User-provided list has 27 OPDs; app default master has an additional BPKAD, so account JSON contains 28 Operator OPD accounts.
Secret JSON is minified and intentionally omits optional enabled and OPD displayName fields to fit Cloudflare 5 KB value limit. The parser defaults enabled to true and display name to username.
Credentials in the separate JSON/CSV are initial passwords; treat both files as confidential.
Cloudflare D1, real Google Sheets/Drive OAuth, R2 access and all workbook identifiers still require live production acceptance tests.
Role Auditor diubah menjadi allowlist API eksplisit; role lain tetap memakai aturan akses sesuai cakupannya.
